path_metrics.ETHBTC_MAE_MFE: min/max percentage return from baseline over direct hourly ETHBTC closes from baseline through selected horizon end
path_metrics.secondary_BTC_ETH: also retain BTC and ETH forward return plus BTC/ETH MAE/MFE using direct retained Binance spot hourly closes for tail-risk diagnostics

primary_classification.baseline: latest direct settled hourly ETHBTC close at or before information_cutoff_utc
primary_classification.missing: if no qualifying direct close exists, horizon remains unmatured/unavailable
primary_classification.source: direct retained Binance ETHBTC settled hourly closes
primary_classification.target_selection: first direct settled hourly close at or after exact horizon target and no more than 60 minutes after target
